recommendation: Keep this source fix. It resolves the remaining built-page inconsistency for FHIR-47237 without adding broader veterinary-specific guidance or changing unrelated NutritionProduct text.
issue_request: FHIR-47237 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO clarification asking whether NutritionProduct was limited to food products for human consumption. The approved resolution says NutritionProduct can also be used for animal consumption and the Scope and Usage sentence should say products for consumption.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit d0f9f0cb92 updated source/nutritionproduct/nutritionproduct-introduction.xml so the resource Scope and Usage sentence now says products for consumption. A later FHIR-46343 commit added source/nutrition-module.html with a NutritionProduct summary that still said products were intended for human consumption.
additional_context: NutritionProduct is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/hierarchy.xml includes nutrition-module.html as the built Nutrition page. OO Nutrition minutes for 2024-10-23 record the 8-0-0 FHIR-47237 vote. Zulip searches for NutritionProduct animal and human consumption found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/nutrition-module.html so the NutritionProduct summary says consumable food products are intended for consumption, aligning the module page with the already-correct resource Scope and Usage sentence.
source_changes: source/nutrition-module.html: removed "human" from the NutritionProduct summary phrase "intended for human consumption".

related_jiras.note: Added the Nutrition module page after the initial FHIR-47237 application and reintroduced the stale human-only NutritionProduct summary there.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive OO R6 issue asking whether NutritionProduct is limited to human consumption and resolving that it can also be used for animal consumption.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the approved clarification: NutritionProduct scope should say products for consumption rather than products for human consumption.

evidence_items.summary: The resource Scope and Usage sentence already says NutritionProduct includes food products for consumption.
evidence_items.learned: The original requested resource-page sentence was applied before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: The built Nutrition module page still described NutritionProduct food products as intended for human consumption before this commit.
evidence_items.learned: This remaining built source location would preserve the ambiguity FHIR-47237 resolved, so it needed the same clarification.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-47237-tagged commit changed source/nutritionproduct/nutritionproduct-introduction.xml from human consumption to consumption.
evidence_items.learned: This identifies the initial application and shows why only the later module-page inconsistency remained.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-46343 added source/nutrition-module.html with a NutritionProduct summary saying intended for human consumption.

evidence_items.summary: OO Nutrition minutes list FHIR-47237 with Leslye Rauth/Sandra Miller 8-0-0.
